metadata.title: Tenere Youth Initiative

metadata.motto: The desert is not empty. No one crosses the Ténéré alone.

about.title: Our story, our commitment
about.intro: Tenere Youth Initiative was born from the conviction that young people of pastoralist and nomadic communities carry the solutions of tomorrow.

history.title: Our story
history.body: Founded by young leaders from the Sahel's pastoral areas, the organization grew around a simple idea: no one understands a territory's challenges better than those who live there. From the first community workshops to a regional network, we have built, step by step, a rooted and ambitious youth movement.
